entries.clue: Six short tones on the radio, marking the exact instant
Only a day ago, and already forever out of reach
Named stretch of the past: the Stone one, or the Bronze
Highland empire whose relay runners could carry word a thousand miles in a week
Spring-loaded device that grips a crack when the trigger is let go
Deep split in ice, sometimes hidden under a snow bridge
Rock debris heaped at the foot of a cliff, also known as talus
The very top, and the point of the whole exercise
Modern republic whose capital sits on the drained lake bed of the Aztec one
Preserved royal body kept in its palace, fed and paraded at great festivals
Stepped field cut into a mountainside so that crops could climb the slope
Kitchen gadget you set for the eggs, and it pings
To descend by sliding down a doubled rope under control
January to December: one lap of the sun, taking 365 days and a quarter
